crash_points.name: BeforeTempFileCreate
crash_points.observed_outcome: Zero bytes written, no .tmp or target file on disk. Clean recovery.

crash_points.name: DuringPartialShardWrite
crash_points.observed_outcome: Incomplete shard discarded; staging .tmp removed or unindexed. No corrupt target published.

crash_points.name: AfterBytesWrittenBeforeFsync
crash_points.observed_outcome: File write aborted prior to barrier; staging uncommitted.

crash_points.name: AfterFsyncBeforeRename
crash_points.observed_outcome: Tmp file fsync'd but not renamed to final container path. Node daemon ignores uncommitted staging.

crash_points.name: AfterRenameBeforeParentDirSync
crash_points.observed_outcome: Atomic rename succeeded in dentry; self-verifying container validated on disk.

crash_points.name: AfterParentDirSync
crash_points.observed_outcome: Directory entry fully durable on persistent media.

crash_points.name: AfterWalAppendBeforeWalSync
crash_points.observed_outcome: Unsynced WAL record detected as torn/truncated on startup; rolled back cleanly.

crash_points.name: AfterWalSyncBeforeQuorumCommit
crash_points.observed_outcome: WAL state safely recorded; coordinator quorum handles commit.

crash_points.name: AfterManifestCommitBeforeClientAck
crash_points.observed_outcome: Object is committed and durable; client retry resolves safely via idempotency.

crash_points.name: ImmediatelyAfterClientAck
crash_points.observed_outcome: Client received ack; post-ack SIGKILL preserves 100% object durability.

crash_points.name: DuringRepairJournalUpdate
crash_points.observed_outcome: Durable repair journal transitions committed with fsync.

crash_points.name: DuringShardReplacement
crash_points.observed_outcome: Replacement shard written atomically with fsync.

crash_points.name: DuringMetadataSnapshotReplacement
crash_points.observed_outcome: Snapshot bundle exported and restored atomically.

crash_points.name: DuringGcQuarantine
crash_points.observed_outcome: Quarantine move executed atomically without leaking unreferenced files.

crash_points.name: DuringPhysicalShardDelete
crash_points.observed_outcome: Physical deletion followed by parent dir sync; live shards unharmed.
